thread:
Asha (CS): Heads up — we9ve detected elevated auth latency affecting a small group of onboarding tenants (around 14 accounts, mostly EMEA). Need a quick customer acknowledgment + office hours. Marcus, what9s the mitigation status?

Marcus (Eng Oncall): Mitigation rolling. We pushed a config rollback to canary ~10m ago; canary p95 improved ~60%. Validating rollout on EU clusters now.

Asha (CS): Ok. We should send a short, empathetic acknowledgement to affected customers now: ETA window, office hours invite, and a troubleshooting one-liner. Drafting now.

Priya (CS Ops): Keep broadcast concise. Segment messaging: enterprise gets a personalized outreach + phone, SMBs get the broadcast + office hours. Include a goodwill credit note for high-touch customers.

Asha (CS): DRAFT for broadcast: 

"Hi <CustomerName>, we9re seeing intermittent auth latency in EU affecting some onboarding flows. Engineers are rolling a mitigation now; you may experience slower sign-in or provisioning for up to ~2 hours. Quick try: retry the operation once or restart your client. Office hours for affected customers at 14:00 UTC (link below). Reply here if you9d like prioritized help. We9re sorry for the disruption D Asha, Customer Success"

Julian (SE): Add status page link + one-liner for support to capture request id/timestamp if issue persists.

Asha (CS): Updated DRAFT (v2): 

"Hi <CustomerName>, we9re seeing intermittent auth latency in EU which may slow sign-in or provisioning. We9re rolling a fix now and expect stabilization within ~2 hours. Quick try: retry the operation once; if problems persist, capture timestamp + request id and reply here. Office hours: 14:00 UTC (https://status.redwood.example/incident/INC-2026-042). We9ll post an RCA in 24D48h and reach out directly to enterprise customers. Apologies D Asha, CS"

Priya (CS Ops): Good. I9ll build the recipient segments and send the broadcast in ~10 minutes. I9ll also queue the enterprise call list and the credit template for follow-up.

Raj (Product): For the RCA, capture root cause (auth-cache TTL change triggered cache churn and KMS call spikes), timeline, impacted accounts/regions, mitigation details, and long-term prevention (canary gating + alerting on auth retry rates).

Marcus (Eng Oncall): Confirming root cause: a recent auth-cache TTL tweak caused cache evictions under load on EU proxies, which amplified token validation calls to KMS. Mitigation: reverted TTL and added a temporary circuit-breaker. Will attach metric graphs in the RCA.

Incident Bot: Incident INC-2026-042 created. Status: mitigation in progress (canary green, EU rollout underway). Pager: @marcus.

Asha (CS): Action items: Priya - send broadcast to SMB/onboarders + schedule enterprise calls. Julian - paste troubleshooting snippet and status link. Marcus - confirm when rollout 100% and share post-mitigation metrics. Raj - start RCA draft; CS will prepare the customer-facing summary.

Julian (SE): Troubleshooting snippet for customers/support: `If you hit a failed auth, retry once. If it persists, record the timestamp and request-id from your client logs and include them when you contact support.` Status page: https://status.redwood.example/incident/INC-2026-042

Marcus (Eng Oncall): EU rollout reached 100% at +28m from canary. p95 latency returned to baseline across EU clusters. I9ll upload the metric snapshots and logs to the RCA doc.

Asha (CS): Great. Priya, please proceed with segmented outreach. I9ll host office hours and capture customer feedback for the exec summary. We aim to publish an internal RCA within 24h and a customer-facing summary within 48h.

Priya (CS Ops): Broadcast sent to SMB/onboarders at 1720001300. Enterprise invites dispatched; follow-up calls starting now. Including the standard goodwill credit offer where appropriate.

Asha (CS): Thank you everyone. Please drop any office hours notes and customer quotes in the RCA doc so we can include them in the postmortem and exec briefing. :thumbsup:
